svg.title: Object Model — Diffraction
svg.desc: UML-style object model of pytex.diffraction: diffraction geometry and radiation specification, powder, SAED, Kikuchi and composite patterns, and the kinematic simulation configuration and spot tables behind them.
svg.text: Geometry, radiation, patterns, and the kinematic simulation objects
composition - a required field: the owner cannot exist without it
association - an optional or defaulted field
ProvenanceRecord is omitted: 103 classes carry it, on every result object.
Fields naming another card are listed first; the rest are summarized.
